# vastworld.ai — source hotspots (scroll / animation / 3D drivers)

## Deployment shape

The whole site ships as **one Astro client bundle**:

- `https://vastworld.ai/_astro/layout.astro_astro_type_script_index_0_lang.D-sWMgNi.js` — 5,968,180 bytes raw / 2,012,012 bytes br, 17,449 lines (avg ~342 chars/line, so line numbers are region markers, not precise units). Everything below is inside this single file. [seen]
- No source maps deployed: the bundle declares `//# sourceMappingURL=oldWorker-DUF0ALOS.js.map` but `https://vastworld.ai/_astro/oldWorker-DUF0ALOS.js.map` returns an HTML 404. No original file names, no per-module line ranges. All positions below are **char offsets (idx) and containing line numbers in the deployed bundle**; all identifiers are minified. [seen]
- Worker: the Spark splat worker is a ~2,115,469-byte script instantiated 9x as `blob:` workers (three.js r180 + Spark + `spark_worker_rs` wasm-bindgen glue, identified at idx ~742,127). [seen]

Evidence base: full-byte download `_dl/fresh/layout.js` + retained REA network/scenario records. Method: token/context scans (`_tools/hotspots.cjs`, `hotspots2.cjs`, `scan.cjs`) over the exact bytes the browser executed. [seen]

## Runtime globals exposed by the site (for future probes)

- `window.lenis` (+ `window.lenis.version` = "1.3.26"), `window.__FIRST_WORLD__` (random int 0..10 set by inline script), `document.documentElement.dataset.world` (current world id). [seen]
- `window.THREE`, `window.gsap`, `window.barba` are **not** exposed (module-scoped). [seen]
